fields.name: rawText

fields.name: lineCount
fields.description: Number of physical source lines; empty string counts as zero.

fields.name: expectedEvents

fields.name: expectedReviewFlags

fields.name: expectedNonEvents

fields.name: expectedTimelineOrder

fields.name: expectedExport
fields.description: Semantic export assertions independent of serialization; visible and all extracted IDs, review codes, evidence and disclaimer.
